title: Barnaby and the Whispering Key
logline: A curious clockwork owl discovers a floating key that unlocks an attic filled with forgotten living stories.

character_bible.name: Barnaby
character_bible.visual_appearance: small brown barn owl crafted with polished bronze gears and soft golden feathers
character_bible.signature_clothing: cozy forest-green wool scarf fastened with a tiny brass acorn pin
character_bible.distinct_accessories: gleaming round monocle over his curious right amber eye

scenes.title: The Clockwork Attic
scenes.narrative_text: High above the sleepy village of Oakhaven, Barnaby fluttered his bronze feathers across stacks of ancient leather-bound books in the secret attic library.
scenes.audio_script: High above the sleepy village of Oakhaven, Barnaby fluttered his bronze feathers across stacks of ancient leather-bound books in the secret attic library.

scenes.title: The Floating Key
scenes.narrative_text: Beneath an antique grandfather clock, a soft golden light shimmered. Suspended in mid-air was an ornate brass key humming with quiet enchantment.
scenes.audio_script: Beneath an antique grandfather clock, a soft golden light shimmered. Suspended in mid-air was an ornate brass key humming with quiet enchantment.
scenes.image_prompt: whimsical storybook illustration, antique grandfather clock in warm attic, glowing ornate brass key floating in mid-air, Barnaby (small bronze owl with golden feathers, forest-green scarf, monocle) looking with wonder, magical sparkles, storybook art

scenes.title: The Secret Doorway
scenes.narrative_text: Guided by the key's gentle glow, Barnaby discovered a hidden keyhole carved into the spine of a massive indigo encyclopedia of forgotten tales.
scenes.audio_script: Guided by the key's gentle glow, Barnaby discovered a hidden keyhole carved into the spine of a massive indigo encyclopedia of forgotten tales.
scenes.image_prompt: whimsical storybook illustration, Barnaby (small bronze owl, forest-green scarf, monocle) inserting glowing brass key into a giant indigo book with ornate gold filigree, soft blue and golden light spilling from the opening door, storybook art

scenes.title: The Garden of Lost Stories
scenes.narrative_text: The book opened into an enchanted indoor conservatory where paper birds sang and forgotten stories bloomed like luminous lanterns among emerald leaves.
scenes.audio_script: The book opened into an enchanted indoor conservatory where paper birds sang and forgotten stories bloomed like luminous lanterns among emerald leaves.

scenes.title: The Keeper of Wonder
scenes.narrative_text: Barnaby realized that every story needed a reader to bring it back to life. With a joyful flutter, he vowed to share the magic with every child in the village.

moral_or_takeaway: Curiosity opens doors, but sharing our stories brings true magic to life.
